No option can be put forward yet because the model could not assess your “monthly churn under 4%” limit.

- The price comparison itself was moderately robust under the model’s tested variations, but that does not establish compliance with the churn requirement.
- The outcome also partly rests on a machine default of £0 for non‑Pro MRR, not a user-provided figure; downstream MRR results are therefore unreliable.
- Active Pro subscribers are the most structurally influential factor, while churn and feature-value inputs are provisional machine-authored estimates. The model also lacks an explicitly recorded goal direction.

This run is a model-relative comparison, not a decision answer.
